Frontend: SwipePicker renders for weight target and duration, Nora Weekly Report card displays stats and AI message.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 100 tested new SwipePicker components for weight target and duration selection in the goal form. The pickers use horizontal scroll with snap-to behavior (data-testid='swipe-picker'). Weight picker shows integers around current weight (e.g., 64-70kg). Duration picker shows fixed week options (2,4,6,8,10,12,16,20,24). Nora Weekly Report card (data-testid='nora-weekly-report') displays weekly stats from GET /api/nora/weekly-report endpoint and AI-generated message. Password changes now persist to /app/backend/password_overrides.json and are re-applied on server startup.
